description: This file implements a ThunderJS module for WebSocket communication, including connection management, request handling, event listening, and plugin registration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with specified options, manages socket events, and resolves or rejects the connection promise.

methods.name: makeWebsocketAddress
methods.description: Constructs a WebSocket URL based on provided options.

methods.name: makeBody
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC request body with given parameters.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Determines the appropriate version for a plugin request based on configuration and parameters.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a unique incremental ID for requests.

methods.name: execRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over an established WebSocket connection.

methods.name: API
methods.description: Creates an API object with a request method for plugin communication.

methods.name: DeviceInfo
methods.description: Provides methods to retrieve device information such as free RAM and version.

methods.name: listener
methods.description: Registers event listeners for plugin events and provides a dispose method.

methods.name: makeListenerId
methods.description: Generates a unique listener ID string based on plugin and event names.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an event callback for a plugin event, optionally sending registration requests.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes an event callback registration and optionally sends an unregister request.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Sets up cleanup callbacks on process or window unload events.

methods.name: thunderJS
methods.description: Main factory function creating a ThunderJS instance with plugin and API methods.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Wraps a result in a Promise and optionally calls a callback.

methods.name: wrapper
methods.description: Creates a Proxy to handle method and property access on ThunderJS objects.

methods.name: ensurePluginContext
methods.description: Ensures correct plugin context and arguments for method calls.
